name: smwmusic-trauma-center-under-the-knife
title: Trauma Center: Under the Knife 2 - A Tough Scenario ~ Gentle Breeze (Remix)
description:
Did an arrangement of Gentle Breeze from Trauma Center: Under the Knife 2. First time I'm doing a track from an Atlus game, and it had to be the one most people nowadays associate with Squidward Tentacles. Though, oddly enough, I was actually inspired to do this after listening to +TEK's FM cover of it while doing errands. Seriously, as much of a meme this song is, it goes incredibly hard. Guess that's the standard for most Atlus games. :)

Important:
♠ "Bonus End" & Thunder SFX are disabled.

There are also customizable pitches for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. C Minor (Original Pitch) [turned on by default]
2. A Minor (Custom Pitch)

There are also customizable versions for this song that you can adjust in the song's txt file:
1. Enables Voice Clip, but at the cost of SMW-Compatibility
2. Disables Voice Clip [turned on default]
